paragraphs.text: Nelly Borca is a Boros human detective of the Wojek League from Ravnica .

Nelly is the niece of Bell Borca , a Boros sergeant best known for having solved his own murder after he died. She grew up listening to tales of his death and subsequent investigations, which inspired her to join the Boros Legion as a Wojek sergeant. In the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion , she was the first and only volunteer to coordinate on a secondment between the Legion and the rapidly growing Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations . Her fellow Boros viewed the posting as a thankless slog, but Nelly saw it as an unparalleled opportunity to learn about investigative procedures and methods. She is bright and eager to make a name for herself. While she takes pride in her instincts, she also tends to jump to conclusions based on her gut feelings. This leads to astonishingly rapid case resolutions, but sometimes ends with wild accusations that are completely off the mark.
